subject: Rescue Drone
reference: Canvas style and current GDD; no dedicated source image.
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a clean grayscale pencil-and-ink 3D MODELING REFERENCE SKETCH SHEET for Fire Slop, a comic stylized rescue game. White background, confident dark contours, very light gray planar shading, simplified chunky low-poly-friendly geometry, few large details. NOT a photoreal render, NOT a screenshot. One consistent object design across all views, uncluttered generous separation, all silhouettes fully in frame. Landscape sheet. Large three-quarter hero view plus smaller aligned front, side and rear or top views as appropriate. Minimal English view labels and title only; no invented dimension numbers, no watermark, no flames, smoke, UI or scene clutter. Shapes must be clear enough for a 3D artist to reconstruct. Title: Rescue Drone. Design one large civilian rescue quadcopter that physically carries a standing firefighter with a civilian on their shoulder; not a small camera drone. Simple chunky oval central hull, exactly four stout arms in X arrangement and four large circular protected rotors, twin sturdy landing skids. Open central standing foot deck below hull with clear simple waist restraint for the pilot, allowing hands free and unobstructed forward first-person view. Keep mechanism simple, plausible stylized arcade construction. Three-quarter hero, top, front and side views of same design. Include only one pale small schematic standing human silhouette in side view for scale; no extra character design. No weapon, water cannon, remote control, enclosed cockpit, rescue basket or second passenger seat. Minimal mechanical detail; broad smooth shells.
notes: Four guarded rotors, landing skids and open standing platform with restraint. Fit the actual firefighter and carried resident under the hull before finalizing size; the pale scale figure is illustrative, not a clearance proof.
